precision_policy: Preserve exactly published precision and approximation labels. No reconstructed historical values from rounded tables or F/X/Y/Z files.

excluded_comparisons.reason: A0 does not rerun baselines; never combine new final metrics with an old baseline as an all-recomputed claim.

unpublished_old_values: component per-seed latencies and component p95
